 WBBL 2026: Match 27, BH W vs ST W Match Prediction – Who will win today’s WBBL match between Brisbane Heat Women vs Sydney Thunder Women?
 The match will be played at Allan Border Field, Brisbane, on November 19.
 By CricTracker Staff Published - 18 Nov 2026, 17:10 IST 
 5 Min Read
 WBBL 2026: Match 27, BH W vs ST W Match Prediction – Who will win today’s WBBL match between Brisbane Heat Women vs Sydney Thunder Women?. (Source:WBBL) Brisbane Heat Women will take on Sydney Thunder Women in Match 27 of the Women's Big Bash League 2026 on Thursday, November 19, at Allan Border Field in Brisbane.  
 Brisbane Heat Women have enjoyed a decent campaign so far, winning four of their six matches and losing two. They are currently third in the points table with eight points and a net run rate of +1.154. The Heat will look to continue their good run and strengthen their position in the top four. 
 Sydney Thunder Women, meanwhile, have had a difficult season, winning only two of their six matches and losing four.
